content_sections.heading: GPRB LRD Vacancy 2026 Increased to 12,752
content_sections.text: Note: These are the revised vacancies announced on 24 November 2026. The Board has stated that the number of vacancies may change. Candidates should check the detailed notification for category-wise and gender-wise reservation information.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police LRD Vacancy 2026 Latest Update
content_sections.text: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board originally announced vacancies in the Lokrakshak and Motor Transport technical cadres. Following additional vacancy approval from the Gujarat Government, GPRB issued an updated notice on 24 November 2026 increasing the Lokrakshak cadre vacancies to 12,752.

content_sections.heading: GPRB PSI Recruitment 2026: 241 Additional Vacancies
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the PSI cadre must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Applications are scheduled to open on 26 November 2026 at 2:00 PM and close on 16 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. GPRB PSI Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF: Click to Download Important: The 241 PSI-cadre vacancies are not part of the 12,752 LRD vacancy count. Across the separately advertised LRD, Motor Transport technical and PSI-cadre recruitments, the combined announced vacancies total 13,152.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying for GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, age limit, physical fitness and other requirements prescribed for their selected post. The official newspaper notification confirms that candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination or possess an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Detailed age and physical eligibility requirements will be provided in the recruitment instructions. Important: This quick eligibility guide does not confirm individual eligibility. Candidates should check the official post-wise eligibility conditions, physical standards and reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: GPRB LRD Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has prescribed the Higher Secondary School Certificate qualification for the Lokrakshak cadre. Eligibility for Unarmed Police Constable, Armed Police Constable, SRPF Constable and Jail Sepoy posts will be governed by the applicable recruitment rules and detailed instructions issued by GPRB. Candidates applying for the Gujarat Police LRD Recruitment 2026 must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination from the Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board or possess an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Candidates applying for the Motor Transport technical cadre must possess the prescribed Class 12 qualification along with specific Motor Mechanic Vehicle trade training or apprenticeship certification.

content_sections.text: GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026: Click to Apply Online Candidates can submit their GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026 application forms through the official OJAS Gujarat website after the application facility opens. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced for GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has increased the Lokrakshak cadre vacancies to 12,752, according to the official update dated 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many Gujarat Police Constable vacancies are available in 2026?
faq.answer: The revised LRD recruitment includes 8,233 Unarmed Police Constable, 1,132 Armed Police Constable, 3,107 SRPF Constable, 251 Male Jail Sepoy and 29 Female Jail Sepoy positions, totalling 12,752 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. When will GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026 applications begin?
faq.answer: The online application process is scheduled to begin on 26 November 2026 at 2:00 PM through the OJAS Gujarat website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The reported last date is 16 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Candidates should confirm the final deadline in the detailed OJAS advertisement because the earlier newspaper notice displays a different closing date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 or the Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination, or possess an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government.

faq.question: Q6. Can 12th-pass candidates apply for Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who have passed Class 12 or possess an equivalent recognised qualification can apply for eligible Lokrakshak posts, subject to age, physical fitness and other recruitment requirements.

faq.question: Q7. Can freshers apply for GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The preliminary advertisement does not specify mandatory prior work experience for Lokrakshak posts. Candidates must meet the prescribed educational and other eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for GPRB LRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The complete age limit is not provided in the supplied preliminary and revised vacancy notices. Candidates should check the detailed recruitment advertisement for the applicable age criteria.

faq.question: Q9. How many Unarmed Police Constable vacancies are available in Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 8,233 Unarmed Police Constable vacancies are included in the revised Lokrakshak cadre vacancy notice dated 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q10. How many SRPF Constable vacancies are announced in GPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The updated vacancy notice includes 3,107 Armed Police Constable (SRPF) vacancies.
